title: Australia’s new gas reservation policy aims to keep supply secure and prices low. Will it work?
paragraphs: Gas exporters will have to reserve up to 20% of their production for the domestic market from 2028 under the federal government’s new domestic gas reservation scheme.
Australia is a major gas producer, but until now, governments on the east coast have had limited capacity to restrict or control gas exports and reserve gas for domestic consumers.
The aim of the new scheme is to increase domestic gas supply, improve energy security and bring prices down.
